notes:
ScreenTale 1.1.1 adds sharper zoomed recordings, fixes exports with audio and makes editing feel immediate.

- New experimental HiDPI capture option in Settings > Recording and the floating bar's Options menu. On a standard-resolution display, macOS draws the recorded display at 2x so zoomed-in footage keeps more detail. It is off by default and asks for confirmation before turning on.
- Zoomed-in screen content is sharper in the preview and in exports.
- Exports that include microphone or system audio no longer fail after all frames have rendered.
- Video exports finish faster: a 1440p 60 fps HEVC export takes about half as long as before.
- Dragging Padding and other Frame settings, or a zoom's Level, now updates the preview while you drag instead of after you let go.
- Sliders no longer jump back and forth while you drag, and the Zoom panel no longer shifts its layout during edits.
